brief:
Ireland is spearheading a push within the European Union to adopt a tougher stance against Israeli occupation activities and settlers operating in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The initiative seeks to expand existing sanctions regimes and impose new restrictions on settlement commerce.

Proposed measures include banning settlement products and services from access to European markets. The effort signals mounting pressure among EU member states to take more concrete action in response to ongoing settlement expansion and related activities in Palestinian territories.
